subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Can a workflow-security owner approve these exact third-party action revisions after verifying that each immutable SHA matches its stated upstream release and that the refreshed head remains clean?
rationale: This PR changes executable supply-chain inputs in workflows that handle security results and registry credentials; automation can identify the boundary but should not independently authorize those third-party revisions.

options.title: Verify and approve the pins
options.body: Confirm the six upstream release-to-SHA mappings, refresh the behind branch, and merge if the exact resulting head remains clean.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Hold the dependency bump if a workflow owner cannot verify a revised action's provenance or compatibility with the existing workflow inputs.
